name: Lobster Tail
body:
Station and Complexity poissonier 3

Flavor Profiles umami, temperature, temperature
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, spicy, sour, sweet, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

Lobster tail is a rich-flavored seafood that is often boiled and served with a butter sauce or velouté.

When consumed, the consumer chooses up to three class skills in which it has at least 1 rank and gains a morale bonus equal to the culinarian’s Intelligence or Wisdom modifier to that skill for the duration.

Every 3 additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 and allow the consumer to select an additional skill.
